frozen_statement: Questions, labels, requirements, claim specifications, acceptable evidence IDs, thresholds and grader semantics are frozen before M4.1.1 strategy changes or formal execution. M3.2 holdout and opened M4.1 datasets are excluded from this final set.

scoring.requirement_coverage: A requirement is covered only when a final major claim cites an acceptable evidence ID for that requirement.
scoring.citation_correctness: Major claims with citations are correct only when each cited ID is an acceptable evidence ID for the claim specification; semantic judgement is separately audited.
scoring.citation_completeness: Required claim specifications represented by a supported final major claim divided by all claim specifications.
scoring.major_fact_support_rate: Supported final major claims divided by all final major claims.
scoring.unsupported_major_claim_count: Final major claims without a valid supported citation.
